reports.title: Progyny, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: As the fourth quarter begins, member activity continues to remain healthy. In light of the strong results over the first nine months of the year, as well as our expectations for member engagement over the remainder of the year, we're raising the midpoint of our full year guidance.

The majority of the clients and lives added in the most recent selling season are expected to go live in the first quarter of 2027, though a meaningful number of lives are expected to launch mid-year. In addition, a number of the newest clients have already launched their benefit in 2026. Once all new clients are live in 2027, the Company anticipates having in excess of 660 clients, representing approximately 8.3 million covered lives.

As it relates to 2027, consistent with past practice, the Company anticipates providing financial guidance when it reports its year-end results in February. The Company is providing the following financial guidance for both the three-month and full year periods ending December 31, 2026.

oRevenue is projected to be $1.365 billion to $1.385 billion, reflecting growth of 5.9% to 7.5%; excluding the $48.5 million of revenue in 2025 from the large client who was under a transition agreement in the first half of 2025, revenue is expected to increase by 10.1% to 11.7%

oNet income is projected to be $107.0 million to $110.6 million, or $1.30 to $1.35 per diluted share, on the basis of approximately 82.0 million assumed weighted-average fully diluted-shares outstanding
oAdjusted EBITDA1 is projected to be $235.0 million to $240.0 million
oAdjusted earnings per diluted share1 is projected to be $2.09 to $2.13
